heightNote: Ground level per tile: 0 = Crab Basin floor, 1 = normal ground, 2 = Wire Ridge and junk mounds. One level = 16 px. Walking between tiles of different height is only possible on ramps. Draw rules: tiles/slums/slums-elevation-README.md.
wallsNote: Wall material for a raised tile's visible walls (tile-slums-cliff-<material>-l|r-N.png, variant seeded by col,row).
rampsNote: Each ramp is 2 tiles: part 1 is the low tile, part 2 the next; the tile after part 2 is the high ground. dir = the way you walk up. Ramp tiles keep the low height in "height"; a character on part 1 stands 0-8 px up and on part 2 8-16 px up, along the slope.

boss.name: Scrapheap Golem
boss.note: Rises in the golem pit. Chat line 5 min before and when it rises.

notes: The Slums: the first mob map, west of the town (the town's west road gate leads here and arrives at "arrive.town"). Levels run east to west: Tin Can Alley (1-2) and Bottle Cap Lot (2-3) by the camp, Tire Yard (3-5) and Bag Flats (4-6) before the canal, Wire Ridge (6-8) up on the plateau, Crab Basin (7-9) down in the drainage basin, and the Scrapheap Golem (10) in the far west junkyard. The camp (safeZone) is where slum residents live: no mobs, mobs leash before reaching it. Objects sit with their manifest anchor on the top corner of tile (col,row), raised by 16 px per height level of that tile.
